title: Jake Barber's consciousness contact with the egg

tellings.quote: Jake had that consciousness contact with the egg he picked up.

plain: Steven Greer, a long-time UFO activist, says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show that a man named Jake Barber, who says he helped recover an egg-shaped unidentified object, had a contact through his consciousness with the egg when he picked it up. If true, it would suggest the object responds to the human mind.
